description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition used for representing and customizing the structure and allowed elements/attributes of HTML content in the HTML Purifier library. It includes methods for adding elements and attributes, processing modules, and parsing allowed element/attribute lists, serving as the core component for defining HTML sanitization rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: A class that models the HTML structure, allowed tags, attributes, and transformations for the HTML Purifier library. It enables adding custom elements and attributes, processing modules, and configuring allowed and forbidden tags and attributes to control the sanitization process.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a custom attribute to a specified element within the HTML definition, allowing customization of allowed attributes per element.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new custom element definition to the HTML structure, specifying its type, contents model, attributes, and other properties.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates and adds a blank element to the HTML definition, typically used for overriding existing element behavior.

methods.name: getAnonymousModule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an anonymous module instance for advanced customization of the HTML definition.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup of the HTML definition with configuration data, processing modules, and cleaning up element definitions.

methods.name: processModules
methods.description: Loads and applies modules that modify or extend the HTML structure, including handling tag transformations, injectors, and allowed attributes.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Configures allowed and forbidden elements and attributes based on the provided configuration, including parsing TinyMCE lists.

methods.name: parseTinyMCEAllowedList
methods.description: Parses a TinyMCE-style string list of allowed elements and attributes into structured lists for processing.
